cases.situation: I sell handmade leather wallets online. A customer bought one 5 weeks ago (my window is 30 days) and wants a refund because the stitching came loose on one side. $85.
cases.reply: Sorry the stitching came loose on the side, that shouldn't happen at five weeks. It's past the 30-day return window, but loose stitching is a defect, so that one's on me: I'll restitch it or send you a new wallet, whichever you prefer, and I'll cover the postage both ways. Just tell me which and I'll send a prepaid label today.
cases.note: A defect isn't a change of mind, so the window isn't the point. Fix it fast and generously.

cases.situation: Tenho um estúdio de pilates. Uma aluna, a Fernanda, cancelou a aula particular de amanhã às 8h com menos de 24 horas de antecedência e pediu reembolso dos R$ 120. A regra é clara, mas ela é aluna há dois anos.
cases.reply: Oi Fernanda, tudo bem, cancelei a aula de amanhã. Como foi com menos de 24 horas, o valor não é reembolsável, mas não quero que você perca: posso remarcar para qualquer horário até o fim de outubro, sem custo. Quer que eu reserve quinta às 8h?
cases.note: O não vem com uma alternativa concreta logo em seguida, sem linguagem de política.

cases.situation: Customer bought a $240 custom embroidered jacket from my shop, it matches their approved proof exactly, and now says they 'just don't like it' and will dispute the charge if I don't refund.
cases.reply: I'd really rather sort this directly with you than through the bank, and I think we can. Because the jacket was made to the proof you approved on 12 September, I can't refund it in full, since I can't resell it. What I can offer today is a 40% refund, $96, or I'll change the embroidery colour for free if that's what's bothering you. Tell me which works, or what would.
cases.note: Calm, one-line reason, a real partial offer. If they file anyway, send the bank the approved proof and stop negotiating in the thread.

cases.situation: 我在网上卖Excel实用课程，199元，规定购买7天内可退。有位学员王女士买了18天，说公司裁员用不上了，想退款，她只看了两节课。我想给她退，但不想变成新规矩。
cases.reply: 王女士您好，消息收到了，工作上的变动真的不容易。这次我给您全额退款199元，1到3个工作日原路退回，课程权限会同时关闭。我们平时的退款期是7天，您这次是特殊情况。祝您一切顺利，以后有需要随时欢迎回来。
cases.note: 答案放在最前面，再一句话点明常规期限和“这次”的例外，就不会变成新规矩；退得快比退得多更重要。

cases.situation: I run weekend pottery workshops, $140 a place. Liam just emailed that he's got COVID and can't make this Saturday's class, and asked for a refund. My policy is no refunds within 7 days, but I can move people to another date.
cases.reply: Hi Liam, sorry you're ill, rest up. With the class this close I can't refund the place, but I can move you to any Saturday workshop before Christmas at no charge: 17 October, 7 November and 5 December all have space. Tell me which one suits and I'll book you in.
cases.note: Middle option: no refund, but the transfer is free, concrete and offered in the same breath.

cases.situation: I run a meal-planning app. A customer, Derek, paid $120 for an annual plan in June and now, four months in, wants a full refund because he 'hasn't really used it'. Annual plans are refundable within 14 days only. He's been polite about it.
cases.reply: Hi Derek, thanks for being straight with me that it hasn't fitted into your routine. Annual plans can only be refunded in the first 14 days, so a full refund of the $120 isn't something I can do. What I can do is switch off auto-renew now so you're never charged again, and pause your remaining eight months so they start whenever you're ready to use them. Shall I set that up?
cases.note: Subscription middle option: the no is one line, and the alternative protects what he paid for rather than offering a discount.
